results.question: Can I return an opened laptop on day 8 if I have the original box and all accessories?
results.answer: Yes. Opened laptops can be returned within 10 days of delivery. On day 8, you can return it if it’s in good condition with no physical damage and includes the original box, all accessories, manuals, and invoice.

results.question: My Galaxy Buds3 Pro left earbud won't connect. Is this a known issue, and has the same problem been resolved for another customer? What fixed it?
results.answer:
Yes. This is a known issue that can happen after pairing the Galaxy Buds3 Pro with a new phone while they’re still paired to the old one. Another customer had the same problem and it was resolved by resetting both earbuds in the case, then pairing them again as a new device.

Try closing the case with both earbuds inside for 10 seconds, then reset them in the Galaxy Wearable app or hold both touchpads for 7 seconds. Pair them again as a new device.
contexts:
[TCK-1001] Left earbud of Galaxy Buds3 Pro not connecting (date: 2026-08-04)
Customer issue: After switching to a new phone, the left Galaxy Buds3 Pro earbud did not connect. Root cause: Earbuds were still paired with the old phone. Resolution: Guided the customer to reset the earbuds in the case and pair again as a new device, as per KI-001. Both earbuds worked after the reset. Status: Resolved.

[KI-001] Galaxy Buds3 Pro: one earbud not connecting (date: 2026-07-01)
Customers report that one Galaxy Buds3 Pro earbud, usually the left one, does not connect after pairing with a new phone. Fix: put both earbuds in the case, close the lid for 10 seconds, then reset the earbuds from the Galaxy Wearable app or by holding both touchpads for 7 seconds. Pair again as a new device. If the issue continues after reset, treat it as defective under RR-003 within 48 hours of delivery, or as a warranty claim after that.

[FAQ-011] Do Galaxy Buds3 Pro work with iPhones? (date: 2026-07-01)
Yes. Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro work with iPhones as normal Bluetooth earbuds. Some features, such as auto switch between Samsung devices and full app controls, work best with Samsung Galaxy phones.

[KI-002] AirPods Pro 2: one earbud not charging in the case (date: 2026-07-01)
Some customers report that one AirPods Pro 2 earbud does not charge in the case. The usual cause is dirt on the charging contacts. Fix: clean the earbud and case contacts gently with a dry cotton swab and check that the earbud sits fully in the case. If it still does not charge, raise an Apple warranty claim.

[FAQ-009] Do AirPods Pro 2 work with Android phones? (date: 2026-07-01)
Yes. Apple AirPods Pro 2 connect to Android phones as normal Bluetooth earbuds for music and calls. Some features, such as automatic switching between Apple devices and setup through iOS, work only with Apple devices.

results.question: How long does delivery take to a remote pincode, and is it free?
results.answer: Delivery to a remote pincode takes **5–9 business days**. Delivery is free for orders of **Rs 499 or more**; orders below Rs 499 have a Rs 49 delivery charge.
contexts:
[SH-002] Delivery to remote pincodes (date: 2026-07-01)
Remote pincodes include parts of the North-East states, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and some hill areas. Delivery to remote pincodes takes 5 to 9 business days. The normal delivery charges apply, so orders of Rs 499 and above are still free. Express delivery is not available for remote pincodes.

[SH-001] Standard delivery times and charges (date: 2026-07-01)
Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 business days in metro cities and 3 to 6 business days in other serviceable pincodes. Delivery is free for orders of Rs 499 and above. Orders below Rs 499 have a delivery charge of Rs 49.

[TCK-1005] Delivery to Port Blair taking too long (date: 2026-08-22)
Customer issue: Customer in Port Blair complained that a Logitech MX Master 3S order had not arrived after 5 days. Root cause: Port Blair is a remote pincode. Resolution: Explained that remote pincodes take 5 to 9 business days as per SH-002. The order was delivered on day 7. Status: Resolved.

[SH-004] Cash on Delivery limits (date: 2026-07-01)
Cash on Delivery is available for orders up to Rs 50,000. Orders above Rs 50,000 must be paid online. Cash on Delivery is not available for remote pincodes or for express delivery.

[SH-003] Express delivery (date: 2026-07-01)
Express delivery is available in select metro cities: Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Pune. Orders placed before 2 PM are delivered the next day. Express delivery costs Rs 149 per order, even for orders above Rs 499. Express delivery is not available for Cash on Delivery orders.

[SH-003] Express delivery (date: 2026-07-01)
Express delivery is available in select metro cities: Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Pune. Orders placed before 2 PM are delivered the next day. Standard delivery takes 2 to 4 business days in metro cities and 3 to 6 business days in other serviceable pincodes. Delivery is free for orders of Rs 499 and above. Orders below Rs 499 have a delivery charge of Rs 49.

Remote pincodes include parts of the North-East states, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and some hill areas.
